title: OnboardOS
problem_statement: Mid-size companies (100-1,000 employees) lose an average of $4,000 per new hire to productivity drag in the first 90 days because onboarding is orchestrated through a combination of email chains, manually assigned Jira tickets, and ad-hoc Slack messages that vary by manager and break down with remote hires (Gallup 2022). IT provisioning, HR documentation, and role-specific training happen in parallel across 4-7 disconnected systems with no single view of completion status, leaving new hires confused and HR teams unable to audit compliance. When a key stakeholder is on leave, entire onboarding tracks stall because there is no automated escalation. A structured onboarding workflow platform that unifies task assignment, progress tracking, and automatic escalation can reduce time-to-productivity for new hires while giving HR the compliance audit trail required for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification.
target_users: HR business partners and People Operations managers at companies of 100-1,000 employees who design and monitor onboarding programs
IT administrators who provision software access, hardware, and system credentials for new hires across 5-10 SaaS tools
Hiring managers who are assigned onboarding tasks (introductions, 30-60-90 day check-ins) and need reminders without manual calendar management
New employees in their first 90 days who need a single source of truth for what they need to complete and by when
user_stories: As an HR business partner, I want to create an onboarding template with tasks, owners, due-date offsets from start date, and dependencies so that every new hire in a given role gets a consistent onboarding experience without me manually recreating it each time

As an HR administrator, I want a completion dashboard showing every active new hire's onboarding progress as a percentage broken down by category (IT, HR, role-specific) so that I can identify who is falling behind without emailing managers

As an IT administrator, I want to receive an automated task to provision software access for a new hire 3 business days before their start date so that accounts are ready on day one without HR manually forwarding the hire email
As a hiring manager, I want to receive a Slack reminder 24 hours before my onboarding task is due so that I complete check-ins on time without maintaining a separate calendar reminder

As a new employee, I want a single checklist view showing all my outstanding onboarding tasks with due dates and instructions so that I know exactly what I need to complete without digging through email

As an HR business partner, I want to generate a compliance report showing completion timestamps and e-signature records for mandatory policy acknowledgment tasks for any hire in the past 12 months so that I can respond to an auditor request within 2 hours

As an HR administrator, I want overdue tasks to automatically escalate to the task owner's manager after 48 hours so that critical onboarding steps don't stall when a single stakeholder is unavailable
acceptance_criteria: HR admins can create an onboarding template with unlimited tasks; each task supports a title, description, owner (by role or individual), due-date offset from start date (-10 to +90 days), optional dependency on another task, and optional file upload or e-signature collection

When a new hire is created in OnboardOS (manually or via HRIS sync from BambooHR or Workday), all tasks from the assigned template are automatically created, assigned, and due dates computed within 5 minutes of hire creation
Task owners receive an email and Slack notification (if Slack is connected) at task creation and a reminder 24 hours before the due date; notification preferences are configurable per account
The HR dashboard shows completion percentage per hire, days since start, and a list of overdue tasks sorted by days overdue, updated in real time as task owners mark tasks complete
Mandatory policy acknowledgment tasks support PDF display and e-signature collection within OnboardOS; signature timestamps are stored and exportable in PDF audit format
Overdue tasks automatically escalate by sending a Slack DM and email to the task owner's manager (as defined in the org chart) after 48 hours; escalation is logged in the task history
The compliance report for a specified hire and date range generates as a PDF within 30 seconds and includes task name, owner, due date, completion date, and e-signature record where applicable
OnboardOS syncs new hire data from BambooHR and Workday via API; new hires created in the HRIS appear in OnboardOS within 15 minutes of the HRIS record being saved

success_metrics.metric: New hire 30-day task completion rate (percentage of onboarding tasks due in the first 30 days marked complete within 2 business days of their due date)
success_metrics.baseline: Estimated 58% on-time task completion based on pre-launch customer audit of 3 beta companies using email-based onboarding
success_metrics.target: 82% on-time task completion rate across all active OnboardOS customers within 60 days of adoption

success_metrics.metric: IT provisioning lead time (days from HRIS hire record created to all software access tasks marked complete)
success_metrics.baseline: Average 4.2 days across 3 beta customers measured before OnboardOS
success_metrics.target: Median IT provisioning lead time under 1 business day (all access provisioned before hire start date) within 60 days of adoption

success_metrics.metric: HR admin time per new hire onboarding (hours spent by HR on onboarding coordination tasks per hire, excluding template setup)
success_metrics.baseline: Estimated 6.5 hours per hire for manual coordination, based on time-tracking study with 4 HR teams
success_metrics.target: HR admin time below 1.5 hours per hire within 90 days of OnboardOS adoption

success_metrics.metric: Monthly recurring revenue (MRR) from paying customers
90-day customer retention (customers still on a paid plan in month 4 after their first invoice)
success_metrics.target: 85% 90-day customer retention within 6 months of GA

risks_open_questions: BambooHR and Workday API access requires customer IT approval and credentials sharing; onboarding friction at the HRIS integration step may cause customers to use manual mode only, reducing the product's core value proposition

E-signature legality varies by country: qualified electronic signatures (QES) required in EU under eIDAS may not be satisfied by a click-to-sign approach; need legal review before enabling EU customers

Template flexibility vs. guardrails: customers want highly customizable templates but overly complex templates lead to poor completion rates and support burden; need to define a maximum task limit per template and test with beta customers

Org chart data needed for escalation: many customers do not maintain a clean org chart in an HRIS; need a fallback mechanism (manual manager mapping in OnboardOS) for companies without structured reporting chains

Pricing model: per-seat (per active employee) vs. per-hire (per onboarding cycle started) — per-hire aligns value delivery but creates unpredictable monthly costs for customers with lumpy hiring schedules
How should OnboardOS handle contractor onboarding, which often has different compliance requirements and shorter timelines than full-time employee onboarding?
What is the migration path for customers with existing onboarding checklists in Notion, Confluence, or Google Docs — do we offer a template import tool or manual re-entry only?
out_of_scope: Performance management or 90-day review workflows beyond task tracking
Learning management system (LMS) or course authoring; OnboardOS links to external training resources but does not host video or course content
Offboarding workflows in v1 (post-GA roadmap item)
Integration with ATS (Greenhouse, Lever) for pre-hire onboarding in v1
Multi-language localization beyond English at launch
Analytics on onboarding program effectiveness (correlation with retention or ramp time) at launch
